title: Improve Harnix workflow through self-hosting
goal: Make the generated Harnix workflow and global skills operationally precise enough that an agent can persist and resume every stage safely while discovering only current, relevant repository context.
nonGoals: Implement the repository scanner or code indexer planned by the user.
Add an eighth public command or a new task-state schema.
Install or mutate user-global platform integrations.
Commit, push, publish, or create a pull request.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Generated workflow instructions define when task state and artifacts are persisted at planning, ready, implementation, verification, and completion boundaries.
Each generated harnix skill states its required incoming state, persisted transition or checkpoint, and safe exit condition without creating a second workflow.
Workflow guidance treats config profile data as a seed, verifies current repository evidence, and forbids broad repository dumps in favor of bounded relevant context.
Material research artifacts record conclusion and remaining uncertainty with provenance.
Canonical docs, generated templates, runtime helpers, changelog, and regression tests remain consistent and pass focused plus full verification.

validationPlan.description: Run workflow template, task state, and research regression tests.
validationPlan.command: pnpm exec vitest run test/workflow/routing.test.ts test/workflow/templates.test.ts test/unit/task-state.test.ts

validationPlan.description: Run the complete test suite and build on the current tree.

evidence.summary: Focused RED run failed on the missing persistence guidance and remaining-uncertainty rendering, as intended.
Focused workflow, template, research, and task-state tests passed 26/26; TypeScript typecheck also passed.
Built Harnix and dogfooded project update: workflow.md updated while AGENTS.md and the common guide were preserved.
Stage 1 compliance review matched all requested workflow boundaries, confirmed seven public commands, no task/context schema or dependency change, valid Full artifacts, and generated/source parity.
Full suite had one failure: the current lock generator version assertion was hardcoded to stale 0.5.0 while 272 tests passed; lint and build passed.
The single stale-version hypothesis was confirmed; using packageVersion for the current generated lock assertion passed file-lock tests 7/7 while preserving the legacy 0.5.0 fixture.
Fresh TypeScript typecheck and ESLint checks passed on the current tree.
Fresh full suite passed 273 tests with 1 platform-conditional skip, followed by a successful production build.

Final scope and diff review passed; doctor found no errors and only one existing user-owned AGENTS ownership warning plus 28 out-of-scope outdated global skill warnings. No global mutation was performed.
